summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to terminate the tax-exempt status of organizations that the Secretary of the Treasury designates as having provided more than a minimal amount of material support or resources to terrorist organizations within a three-year period, after providing notice and an opportunity to cure or appeal.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to terminate the tax-exempt status of organizations found to be supporting terrorism. By removing tax-exempt status, these organizations would become subject to taxation, which would lead to higher taxes for them. This is a central aspect of the bill.
